unverified: Front Street, Grandview Parkway, and US 31 through town change posted speed by block. An untagged piece stays at the class default until a sign is read.

Untagged residential, living street, service, unclassified, and tertiary roads are assumed 25 mph. A tertiary road posted above the cap would show as legal until a sign or a DOT speed is added. Those roads are listed for a person to check. A posted sign still wins.

sources.label: MCL 257.657a (golf carts need a city resolution)

enforcement.note: Searched the Traverse City code (codified through Ordinance 1236) and the web for a golf cart resolution under MCL 257.657a. None was found, so plain golf carts stay off public streets. Low-speed vehicles follow MCL 257.660(8): streets posted 35 mph or less, cross a faster street. No MDOT prohibition list for this city was found.
